age.Description: Age of the participant at the time of the recording session

sex.Description: Sex assigned at birth, as self-reported by the participant

handedness.Description: Upper-limb (hand) dominant laterality, assessed with an adapted version of the Harris Test of Lateral Dominance prior to the experimental session

footedness.Description: Lower-limb (foot) dominant laterality, assessed with an adapted version of the Harris Test of Lateral Dominance prior to the experimental session
